items.title: Chanthaburi
items.subtitle: Town in Thailand
items.description:
Chanthaburi is a town in the east of Thailand, on the banks of the Chanthaburi River. It is the capital of the Chanthaburi Province and the Mueang Chanthaburi District.
The town covers the two tambons Talat and Wat Mai of Mueang Chanthaburi District. As of 2005, the town had a population of 27,602.

![Chanthaburi: a stopover between Bangkok and Koh Chang](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270342-1672-0139-0000-d9d5a716477b:8)
Chanthaburi is `a lush coastal province in eastern Thailand, located a 4-hour drive (245 kilometers) southeast of Bangkok` . Famous as the "City of Gems" and Thailand’s fruit basket, it is celebrated for its bustling weekend gem markets, heritage waterfront communities, and tropical produce like durian and mangosteen.[](https://www.chowtraveller.com/chanthaburi-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.chowtraveller.com/chanthaburi-thailand/)[[2]](https://www.theblondtravels.com/chanthaburi-the-gem-of-thailand)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chanthaburi_province)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=taqsRuE5e-Q)[[5]](https://www.thailandtourismus.de/fileadmin/user_upload/E_Broschueren/Destinationen/Chantaburi.pdf)

💎 Gem Capital of Thailand

Chanthaburi has been a global center for mining and trading precious stones (rubies, sapphires, and diamonds) for over 500 years.[](https://www.roughguides.com/thailand/east-coast/chanthaburi/) [[1]](https://www.roughguides.com/thailand/east-coast/chanthaburi/)

- **Sri Chan Road ("Gem Road"):** The vibrant heart of the local trade. Buyers, sellers, and polishers flock here to do business in the open.
- **Gems and Jewelry Center:** Visit local museums and retail hubs to see the cleaning, cutting, and polishing processes in action.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Chanthaburi/463) [[1]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Chanthaburi/463)

🍇 Orchards and Cuisine Thanks to its highly fertile soil, the province is renowned across Thailand for its agriculture and seafood.[](https://www.chowtraveller.com/chanthaburi-thailand/) [[1]](https://sunbasket.com/blog/welcome-to-globetrotter/)

- **Fruit Season:** The best time to visit is during the peak fruit season (usually May to July), when you can visit massive orchards to eat fresh durian, rambutan, and mangosteen.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iE0uxoZk-Cg) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iE0uxoZk-Cg)[[2]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Articles/chanthaburi-rayong)[[3]](https://www.greenpearls.com/blog/colorful-thailand-the-chanthaboon-riverside-community/)[[4]](http://www.thailandbestprice.com/thailand/full-day-fruit-orchard-tour-in-chanthaburi)
- **Local Delights:** Due to its proximity to the water and the river running through it, the city is a must-visit for crab, oysters, and famous regional dishes like *Pad Thai Sen Chan* (stir-fried rice noodles).[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chanthaburi) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chanthaburi)[[2]](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/discover-the-charms-of-chanthaburi/)[[3]](https://hotthaikitchen.substack.com/p/pad-thai-has-a-cousin)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZCMNtWNGLcA&t=412)

🏘️ History & Architecture

- **Chanthaboon Waterfront Community:** An old historical settlement along the Chanthaburi River. It features beautifully preserved traditional teak wood houses, street art, and small local cafes.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chanthaburi) 
- **Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception:** Located near the river, this French-inspired Gothic church is the largest Catholic church in Thailand and a striking vestige of the late-19th-century French occupation.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Chanthaburi/463) [[1]](https://iamkohchang.com/guide/chanthaburi.html)[[2]](https://thecoloursofthailand.com/where-to-go/exploring-chanthaburi-riverside-community-on-an-exciting-and-culturally-rich-journey/)[[3]](https://www.usabairiverside.com/)[[4]](https://www.globalbasecamps.com/tours/thailand/cultural-adventure-trat-beaches)

🌴 Nature & Beaches

- **Namtok Phlio National Park:** A short distance from the main city, this lush jungle park is known for its cascading waterfalls and large, natural swimming pools filled with friendly carp fish.[](https://www.thailandtourismus.de/fileadmin/user_upload/E_Broschueren/Destinationen/Chantaburi.pdf) [[1]](https://www.agoda.com/chanthaburi-center/hotel/chanthaburi-th.html)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Namtok_Phlio_National_Park)[[3]](https://seeplaces.com/excursions/thailand/pattaya/chanthaburi-province-and-fishing-village/)[[4]](https://www.thailandwanderlust.com/blog/things-to-do-in-chanthaburi)
- **Scenic Coastal Drives:** The province features a beautiful winding coastline. Driving down to beaches like **Kung Wiman** offers breathtaking ocean views and access to untouched stretches of sand.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iE0uxoZk-Cg) 

For travel details, seasonal fruit festival schedules, and local accommodations, you can check the official [Tourism Authority of Thailand Chanthaburi Guide](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Chanthaburi/463).[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chanthaburi) Chanthaburi - Wikipedia Chanthaburi (Thai: จันทบุรี , pronounced [tɕān.tʰá(ʔ).bū.rīː] ) is a town (thesaban mueang) in the east of Thailand, on the banks ...![](https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSRs0nmxS4dzLgMrcF9ZiVVkF9n1II0StAzyGY4i2szCmByrljXlgcITyrFjlzMD2pfrSuCSQ)
